mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and residential fixed investment signals weakening demand for durable goods and construction, which reduces corporate capital expenditure and future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1550.0 and RSAFS < 360000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening supply chain activity and reduced corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 360000.0 and HOUST > 1550.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 202.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high CPIAUCSL periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 150k signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as rate hikes loom.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (as measured by GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized indicates a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.
